company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited

kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 82 (NSE issue page). At Rs 82: market cap Rs 515.2 cr post-issue; P/E 18.0x FY25 EPS post-issue (11.6x pre-issue, 13.9x pro forma for interest saved); P/B 1.81x; EV/EBITDA 8.0x. Oct-2025 private placement was at Rs 88.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow Rs 1.34 / 11.49 / 32.09 cr FY23-25 against PAT Rs 15.67 / 21.14 / 28.67 cr: cumulative CFO/PAT 68.6% while revenue grew 34% a year. H1 FY26 CFO Rs 62.51 cr (PAT Rs 11.01 cr) as inventory and receivables were released; including H1, CFO exceeds PAT.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Promoters and relatives lend the company Rs 25.75 cr (Sep-2025) at interest (Rs 2.52 cr of interest in FY25) and rent it two properties; managerial pay is modest (Rs 0.66 cr to three promoter directors in FY25). Related-party transactions 3.14% of FY25 revenue. Disclosed and typical of a promoter-funded company.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: JSW Steel Coated Products supplied 90.61% of FY25 steel coils (authorised service partner since 2021); appliances 81.80% of FY25 product revenue; top customer (Amber Enterprises) 15.53% and top-10 67.44%. Typical of a service centre tied to one mill and the appliance PLI ecosystem.

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: 25 delayed RoC filings over five years and a 2021 allotment to a promoter (for the Bombay Steels business transfer) filed with the wrong form and without MGT-14; compounding / adjudication application pending before the RoC. Procedural, rectified with additional fees; no penalty yet.

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: DCF and relative diverge by -71.7% - the divergence is the finding; name its cause

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: RHP not retrievable (not yet on SEBI; NSE copy on a blocked host): FY26 full-year figures and any RHP changes are not reflected

focus.title: Data gap (high)
focus.detail: Audited numbers end 30-Sep-2025 (388 days old); FY26 full-year results not in the document

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Nature, scheme and remaining tenure of the state subsidy (Rs 6.39 cr in FY24) and Continuous Production Scheme benefit

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Terms of the JSW Steel Coated Products service-partner agreement (tenure, exclusivity, pricing)

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 3:1 bonus (08-Jul-2025) is reflected: EPS 4.47 / 5.34 / 7.24 FY23-25 are on the post-bonus count of 3.96 crore shares. A further 9,00,091 shares were placed at Rs 88 on 28-Oct-2025 (4.05 crore shares now).

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax 20.0% of cumulative FY23-25 PBT plus deferred tax (accelerated depreciation on new plants) 4.1%; income tax paid Rs 18.88 cr over three years.

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: No contingent liabilities; capital commitments Rs 3.34 cr (Sep-2025).

comfort.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
comfort.detail: Shah Shah & Shah (peer-reviewed); no qualifications. A previous auditor resigned in Aug-2021, before the current growth phase.

comfort.title: Monitoring agency
comfort.detail: Fresh issue Rs 191 cr: monitoring agency mandatory; to be named in the RHP.

adjustments.reason: Subsidy of Rs 6.39 cr in FY24 (23% of PBT) and Rs 1.00 cr in FY25 (Rs 0.58 cr in H1 FY26). Real cash, but scheme-based and time-bound; the scheme and its remaining tenure are not stated.

adjustments.item: Continuous Production Scheme benefit and other income
adjustments.reason: One-off Continuous Production Scheme benefit of Rs 1.95 cr in FY24.
Insurance claims of Rs 0.11 cr (FY24) and Rs 0.55 cr (FY25); non-recurring.
Mostly on margin-money deposits backing letters of credit for coil purchases, so tied to operations. Shown for information.

adjustments.item: Pro-forma interest saving on Rs 125 cr of debt repaid from the issue (at about 9%)
adjustments.reason: Not an accounting adjustment: shows the earnings the business would report after the issue repays Rs 125 cr of borrowings carrying 8.15-9.25% (p. 110). For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY25 PAT by -4.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY23-FY25 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 23.6x reported and 26.7x adjusted.
